question.text: What percentage of companies globally will fulfill their pre-2026 broiler commitments in 2026 and 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the percentage of global companies reporting in 2026 or 2027 that they have fulfilled the broiler commitments they made before 2026 according to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker) when accessed by Metaculus on January 1, 2028.
question.fine_print:
Specifically, the denominator will be obtained by selecting the "Broiler" issue on the [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) progress tracker, a "Victory Date" of 1990 to 2025, and a "Timeline" of 2026 and after. The numerator will then be obtained by *additionally* selecting the "Reporting Fulfilled" status.

If Chicken Watch ceases reporting or significantly changes its criteria such that previous reporting is not comparable, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I couldn't get the deciding number. The Chicken Watch tracker builds its data in the browser, so none of my page fetches showed any counts, and the obvious API guess (/api/commitments) returned a 404. The current value needs to be read manually with the filters from the fine print.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-12: I fetched chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker with the Broiler filter, the Cage-free filter and an extra timeline filter. Every version showed only the page frame and a "© Chicken Watch 2026" footer, with no counts, statuses or last-updated date. [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Broiler)
- 2026-11-12: The /broiler page gives only background (about 70 billion meat chickens killed a year, example logos such as Nestlé, Subway and Kraft Heinz). It has no commitment counts. [Chicken Watch Broiler](https://chickenwatch.org/broiler)
- My own inference, not a sourced fact: the question's lower bound of 0.862069% equals exactly 7/812, and the upper bound of 14.9015% equals exactly 121/812. That suggests the denominator was about 812 commitments when the question was written, with about 7 (0.86%) marked "Reporting Fulfilled". Please check this on the live tracker.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The count can only change as companies report through 2027, and it is read on 2028-01-01.
- Note on the wording: the numerator is just a status filter. Any qualifying commitment (pre-2026 victory date, 2026-or-later timeline) marked "Reporting Fulfilled" by 2028-01-01 counts, whenever it was fulfilled. Commitments that are dropped could also change the denominator.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-09/10: The Albert-Schweitzer-Stiftung's German "Masthuhn-Report 2026" grades German retailers, manufacturers and fast-food chains against the European Chicken Commitment. Der Westen reports that 97% of German food retail backs the broiler initiative, but describes no real progress on welfare standards. [Mannheim24](https://www.mannheim24.de/verbraucher/masthuhn-report-2026-aldi-sued-fast-food-und-co-im-check-zr-94582147.html), [Der Westen](https://www.derwesten.de/verbraucher/supermarkt-fleisch-huehner-haltung-masthuhn-report-id302196823.html)
- Around August 2026: The Humane League UK reports that KFC and Popeyes have not rejoined the Better Chicken Commitment. Dave's Hot Chicken is the only chain in the group that withdrew still committed. [Farm Change](https://farmchange.substack.com/p/uk-brands-including-burger-king-kfc)
- Around March 2026: The European ChickenTrack 2025 report says the switch to slower-growing breeds still lags far behind the other criteria. Waitrose, Norsk Kylling and REMA 1000 Norge are listed as fully compliant. [Poultry World](https://live.poultryworld.net/the-industrymarkets/market-trends-analysis-the-industrymarkets-2/european-chickentrack-2025-welfare-gains-amid-slow-momentum-on-breed-change/)
- 2026-02-19: Eight businesses owning 18 UK brands (Burger King, KFC, Nando's, Wagamama and others) stepped back from the breed requirement and formed the "Sustainable Chicken Forum". [The Ecologist](https://theecologist.org/2026/feb/19/food-brands-break-frankenchickens-promise)
- February 2026: Faunalytics, citing Chicken Watch data:
  - 6% of global broiler commitments with deadlines of 2025 or earlier are fulfilled, about 1.5 points above the 2024-or-earlier rate.
  - 76% of companies with deadlines of 2025 or earlier have not reported publicly.
  - Fulfillment is 35% in Europe and 1% in North America.
  - For comparison, 64% of cage-free commitments are fulfilled.
  
  [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)

## 4. Base rates
- Fulfillment of broiler commitments is very low and rising slowly: about 4.5% for deadlines of 2024 or earlier versus 6% for 2025 or earlier (as of Feb 2026), so roughly +1.5 points per extra deadline year. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- The ChickenTrack 2024 edition (published 2025) found that of 93 European companies tracked, 29 disclosed nothing, and only Schiever reported full compliance on breed. [Poultry World](https://www.poultryworld.net/the-industrymarkets/market-trends-analysis-the-industrymarkets-2/better-chicken-commitment-reveals-limited-progress-ahead-of-2026-deadline/)
- The Humane League (2024) found 34% of 384 European commitments reporting progress, which is not the same as fulfilled. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/?p=93640)
- Rethink Priorities has background on how often companies meet these commitments. [Rethink Priorities](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/will-companies-meet-their-animal-welfare-commitments/)
- Seasonality: I found no past snapshots of this exact filtered series. Reporting is clustered, with corporate ESG reports in spring, ChickenTrack around March, and US BCC progress reports in Q1. Most changes in the series probably happen in the first half of each year.
- The filtered set (pre-2026 victories with deadlines in 2026 or later) is mostly European Chicken Commitment pledges due in 2026 and US commitments due in 2026 or later. That subset could be different from the 6% figure, and my bounds-based inference puts it at only about 0.86%.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the collected Kalshi or Polymarket markets match this question. They cover broiler production, wholesale wing prices, menu prices and unrelated topics.
- Manifold has a related but different question: "When will 25% of UK broilers be slower-growing breeds?" [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/daniel0987654/when-will-25-of-broiler-chickens-in)
- I found no Metaculus history or expert forecast for this exact series.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-12-31: The main European Chicken Commitment deadline. Fulfillment reports for 2026 would mostly arrive in Q1-Q2 2027 through company ESG reports and the European ChickenTrack 2026 (likely around March 2027).
- Chicken Watch updates. Its update frequency is unknown, and if data entry lags, numbers on 2028-01-01 could understate real progress.
- More withdrawals, like the UK breed walkback, could cut the numerator. They could also cut the denominator if Chicken Watch removes withdrawn commitments.
- Expected spring 2027 releases: The Humane League's State of the Chicken Industry, Compassion in World Farming's US/EU tracking, and Albert-Schweitzer-Stiftung follow-ups.
- Not weather dependent.

Sources: [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Broiler), [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/), [Poultry World](https://www.poultryworld.net/the-industrymarkets/market-trends-analysis-the-industrymarkets-2/better-chicken-commitment-reveals-limited-progress-ahead-of-2026-deadline/), [Poultry World ChickenTrack 2025](https://live.poultryworld.net/the-industrymarkets/market-trends-analysis-the-industrymarkets-2/european-chickentrack-2025-welfare-gains-amid-slow-momentum-on-breed-change/), [The Ecologist](https://theecologist.org/2026/feb/19/food-brands-break-frankenchickens-promise), [Farm Change](https://farmchange.substack.com/p/uk-brands-including-burger-king-kfc), [Rethink Priorities](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/will-companies-meet-their-animal-welfare-commitments/), [Mannheim24](https://www.mannheim24.de/verbraucher/masthuhn-report-2026-aldi-sued-fast-food-und-co-im-check-zr-94582147.html), [Der Westen](https://www.derwesten.de/verbraucher/supermarkt-fleisch-huehner-haltung-masthuhn-report-id302196823.html), [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/daniel0987654/when-will-25-of-broiler-chickens-in)

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-12: Chicken Watch's tracker page (Broiler filter) showed no counts, statuses or filters to my fetch tool. The only date on the page is "© Chicken Watch 2026". [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Broiler)
- 2026-11-12: The Broiler overview page gives no fulfilment statistics either. [Chicken Watch Broiler](https://chickenwatch.org/broiler)
- How it resolves: the denominator is broiler commitments won in 1990 to 2025 with deadlines in 2026 or later. The numerator is those marked "Reporting Fulfilled" when Metaculus checks on 2028-01-01. A commitment marked fulfilled before 2026 would probably also count, since only the status at that date matters.
- To check by hand: open the tracker, choose Broiler, Victory Date 1990 to 2025 and Timeline 2026+, note the count, then add "Reporting Fulfilled".

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles it yet. The question's range (0.86% to 14.9%) suggests the current figure is low, probably in the low single digits. That is my inference, not something I verified.
- 2026-03-25: Faunalytics, using Chicken Watch data from February 2026, reported that only 6% of global broiler (Better Chicken Commitment, "BCC") pledges due by 2025 had been fulfilled. The figure was about 4.5% for pledges due by 2024. Europe was at 35% and North America at 1%. 76% of companies with 2025-or-earlier deadlines had not reported progress. Over 350 BCC pledges are due in 2026. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10: A Der Westen commentary on the German report: 97% of food retailers back the Broiler Chicken Initiative, yet it finds no progress in welfare standards. [Der Westen](https://www.derwesten.de/verbraucher/supermarkt-fleisch-huehner-haltung-masthuhn-report-id302196823.html)
- 2026-11-09: The German Masthuhn-Report 2026 (Albert-Schweitzer-Stiftung) [Mannheim24](https://www.mannheim24.de/verbraucher/masthuhn-report-2026-aldi-sued-fast-food-und-co-im-check-zr-94582147.html):
  - About 20% of the European Chicken Commitment's requirements are in place in Germany.
  - Many companies moved their 2026 target to 2030, and about a quarter of companies that promised reports publish none.
  - Nestlé and Rügenwalder Mühle withdrew their pledges.
  - Hans im Glück, Yorma's and 60 seconds to Napoli meet 100% of the criteria. Aldi Süd scores 54%.
- 2026-06-11: Sprouts Farmers Market reported progress, not full compliance. [MFA timeline](https://mercyforanimals.org/our-impact/meaningful-milestones/)
- 2026-04: Aramark said it has not met its roadmap milestones. Restaurant Brands International reported US progress (Popeyes stocking density) for the first time. [MFA](https://mercyforanimals.org/our-impact/meaningful-milestones/)
- 2026-03-13: ChickenTrack 2025 (Compassion in World Farming) [Retail Insight Network](https://www.retail-insight-network.com/news/european-hotels-and-retailers-advance-on-chicken-welfare-commitments/):
  - More than 410 European signatories; 107 assessed, of which 76 reported.
  - Only Waitrose and REMA 1000 Norge are fully compliant on breed.
  - 36 companies are under 10% on breed transition, 17 at zero.
  - 18 UK brands withdrew.
- 2025: KFC UK&I said it will not meet its 2026 slower-growing breed target. [The Grocer](https://www.thegrocer.co.uk/news/kfc-rows-back-on-better-chicken-commitment-pledge-claiming-industry-is-not-ready/698119.article); [Food Manufacture](https://www.foodmanufacture.co.uk/Article/2025/03/20/frankenchickens-firms-lagging-behind-on-chicken-welfare-commitment/)
- About 2025-08: Waitrose became the first UK retailer to fully meet the BCC. [CIWF](https://www.compassioninfoodbusiness.com/latest-news/our-news/waitrose-achieves-100-better-chicken-commitment/)

## 4. Base rates
- Broiler fulfilment rates have been very low:
  - About 4.5% for pledges due by 2024 and 6% for pledges due by 2025, both measured in February 2026. That is roughly +1.5 points when one more deadline year is included. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
  - October 2023: of 611 broiler commitments, 11 were fulfilled (about 1.8%) and 114 had any reporting (about 19%). [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/s6kAqweGsbZeZFGRZ/intervention-report-ballot-initiatives-to-improve-broiler)
- Cage-free comparison: 64% of egg pledges due by 2025 have been fulfilled. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- 2019 subjective estimates: Founders Pledge put broiler follow-through at about 30%, against 60% for cage-free. [Rethink Priorities](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/will-companies-meet-their-animal-welfare-commitments/)
- Things that may hold the ratio down:
  - The denominator includes pledges due in 2027 to 2030+, which are less likely to be fulfilled by January 2028.
  - North America (1% fulfilled) probably makes up much of the denominator.
  - Withdrawals and deadlines pushed to 2030. I don't know how Chicken Watch treats withdrawn pledges in the denominator.
- Seasonality: no seasonal pattern, but reports cluster in March (ChickenTrack) and spring (corporate ESG reports). Chicken Watch updates may lag. I found no year-by-year series from November to January.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the collected Kalshi or Polymarket markets match this question; they cover broiler production, wing prices, menu prices and other topics.
- Manifold's "When will 25% of UK broilers be slower-growing breeds?" is related but has no usable price. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/daniel0987654/when-will-25-of-broiler-chickens-in)
- I found no Metaculus community forecast or expert forecast for this exact quantity.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-12-31: The deadline for the many BCC and European Chicken Commitment pledges due in 2026. Compliance reports for 2026 will mostly come out in 2027.
- About 2027-03: ChickenTrack 2026, the first report after the deadline. Spring 2027: corporate ESG and animal welfare reports.
- How often Chicken Watch updates its status entries is unknown; you can report errors to track@chickenwatch.org. Any change to its criteria would annul the question.
- Weather is not relevant.

(b) Latest known value: the hard floor of 0.98522% equals exactly 8/812. That implies about 8 of roughly 812 qualifying commitments are marked "Reporting Fulfilled" as of question creation, around November 2026, so about 0.99%.

(c) If nothing changed: about 0.99%.

(d) If the trend continued: the broader broiler fulfilled rate rose about 1.5 points per added deadline year, from 4.5% to 6%. This subset is mostly European Chicken Commitment pledges due at the end of 2026, and those reports arrive in 2027. Europe's fulfillment rate is about 35% for earlier deadlines, while North America's is about 1%. Data entry on Chicken Watch lags.
- Read in January 2028: perhaps 3 to 5%.
- Read in early 2027: about 1 to 1.5%.

(e) Historical variation: the series moves slowly, roughly 1 to 2 points a year for comparable sets. It is lumpy because reporting clusters in spring.

- High: Chicken Watch does a bulk data update from ChickenTrack 2026, marking many European retailers (Waitrose, the Norwegian chains, German discounters) as fulfilled. That could reach 8 to 12%.
